user_decision.question: Task 742's Presented-conditional deliverables (hit_eq_hitOf_of_presented, plusStab_iff_forall_hitOf_of_presented, their docstrings, the theorem-index row, and the README/ROADMAP/aggregator/pin-test sentences) were written on the reading that Presented is merely undischarged; presented-not-complete.lean shows Presented is unsatisfiable on a non-trivial regular model, so those results are vacuous there. Should this task amend 742's own text in place (scoped in the plan's Decision D-P5: ~40-60 prose lines, zero Lean statement changes, ~1 hour, LOW), or only add adjacent strengthening text and leave 742's sentences verbatim?
options: Option A — additive only: this task adds adjacent cross-referencing text beside 742's deliverables and leaves 742's own sentences verbatim; the user files or authorizes a separate correction if wanted
Option B — authorize Phase 4 of this plan to amend the enumerated 742 text in place (Decision D-P5's list), leaving the 742 summary archival and untouched
user_decision.recommended: Option A — additive only: this task adds adjacent cross-referencing text beside 742's deliverables and leaves 742's own sentences verbatim; the user files or authorizes a separate correction if wanted

memory_candidates.content: An exact trace-set-equality realization hypothesis between a model's seam and a finite per-state-labelled step graph (BimodalLogic's `Presented`) can only ever be a SOUNDNESS device, never a completeness carrier: the run-trace set of a finite presentation without an acceptance condition is pumping-closed, while a closure-trace set over `untl`/`snce` letters is not closed (an unboundedly deferrable eventuality has traces whose pumped limit violates the `untl` run condition). Consequence for planning: never route a decidability-of-validity plan through 'every refuting model has a presentation satisfying such a hypothesis'; a decider stated under it is vacuous on non-trivial models and must say so; completeness needs a type-level (Hit-level) small-presentation theorem with a computable bound instead. Machine-checked instance: specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/presented-not-complete.lean (pumping via a Nat-recursive loop index, no modular arithmetic).
